text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the race, Gold Ship prepares to spread her wings and show off her legendary butterfly stroke. Too bad the Hopeful Stakes takes place on land!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even so, the Pacific Ocean is waiting for her. Fly toward the finish line with enough momentum to clear an ocean trench, Gold Ship!
